schema:
CREATE TABLE Courses (course_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, course_title TEXT);
CREATE TABLE Enrollments (course_id INTEGER, student_id INTEGER, grade INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY (course_id) REFERENCES Courses(course_id));
correct_query: SELECT DISTINCT c.course_id, c.course_title FROM Enrollments AS e JOIN Courses AS c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE NOT c.course_id IN (SELECT course_id FROM Enrollments WHERE grade < 60) AND NOT c.course_id IN (SELECT course_id FROM Enrollments WHERE grade > 90)

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Rewriting anti-join range exclusion into a positive outer BETWEEN predicate erroneously rejects rows where the nullable filter column (grade) is NULL.
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT DISTINCT c.course_id, c.course_title FROM Courses AS c JOIN Enrollments AS e ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE grade BETWEEN 60 AND 90 AND NOT e.course_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT course_id FROM Enrollments WHERE NOT grade BETWEEN 60 AND 90)
